design: One base world per seed (workshop-1, library sharing, bounded search) runs to the checkpoint. Matched continuations are forked there; at the boundary the same admitted-workflow creators retire to storage and fresh producers replace them. Invention is frozen in every continuation. Only the successors' knowledge path differs: costly teaching by existing holders, library inspection (2 energy), no transferable knowledge, or a labelled direct-transfer control.
eligibility: at the checkpoint, every settlement has an admitted workflow held by at least one non-creator, and remaining ore >= 1.5 x ore used per tick so far x window
